weaknesses.quote: Every call resends the whole conversation, so the run stays within budget only if each decision costs one reply: tool calls in one reply run in order, and every result comes back before your next turn.
weaknesses.problem: The Turn loop and Status line sections are long and repetitive. They spell out reply shapes, the menus of the first quarter compared with later quarters, and note bookkeeping (Best, Reviews here, the N formula). This adds a lot of load for a flash-class model. It also makes bookkeeping mistakes more likely, and those mistakes then feed into the review-protection logic.
weaknesses.fix: Cut the turn loop to 3–4 rules: always send take_action plus observe in one reply, send a whole quarter in one reply, and on success=false run observe and retry. Make the status line simpler: drop 'Best' and track only 'Review in N' and 'Reviews here'. Merge the duplicated 'never send observe alone' and success=false instructions.

weaknesses.quote: this Skill therefore treats months 5, 11, 17 … 47 as review months (Review in 1) ... in our runs the half-year talk, the bonus and any promotion appeared among the events as months 6, 12, 18 … 48 began
weaknesses.problem: The review timing comes from the team's own observations and differs from the published order (review after the quarter-end phase in months 6, 12, …). It is labelled as an observation, but the whole Step 4 protection window depends on it. If the official configuration follows the handbook order, the agent protects the wrong months. It also has to handle a confusing exception ('keep the Review in 1 protection through that month too').
weaknesses.fix: Define the review window to cover both readings: protect Skill, Network and Output from month 5 until the review talk or promotion result has appeared (month 5, 6 or 7, and so on). Remove the N-formula dependency, so the window ends on the event itself and not on a computed month.

weaknesses.quote: **Level 4 or above:** Skill first, Output second ... Main action Apply for rotation.
weaknesses.problem: The rule says Output is the second priority, but the chosen main action (Apply for rotation: Skill+, Network+) gives no Output. At the same time, Apply for a key project (Output+, Skill+, Network+) is dropped. The Wealth growth plan also depends only on promotion, with no guidance on bonus grades or what to do if Output stalls at higher levels.
weaknesses.fix: From level 4 on, use Apply for a key project as the default main action. Switch to Apply for rotation or Build a mentorship only when Skill fell behind at the last review. Add a rule: after a C grade, or no promotion at two reviews, move Energy to Prepare report materials and set the main action to Showcase results or Report results to your manager for the next half-year.

weaknesses.quote: This Skill therefore treats months 5, 11, 17 … 47 as review months (Review in 1) ... | Review month | step 4 first | (the quarter is already behind you) |
weaknesses.problem: The handbook puts the review after the quarterly phase of months 6, 12, 18 and so on. The Skill moves the deadline to month 5 based on its own runs. The quick-reference row then says the quarter is already behind you, but the month-6 quarterly phase still comes before the review in the published order. The two timelines conflict, so the agent may skip using the review-quarter actions to raise Output and Network before the review.
weaknesses.fix: Make the handbook order the main rule: review after the quarterly phase of months 6, 12 and so on. Use the run-observed early timing only as an extra safeguard. Add a quarterly line for review quarters: send Energy to Prepare report materials or Network maintenance, choose Report results to your manager as the main action, and delete the line saying the quarter is already behind you.

weaknesses.quote: From the second quarter on, the menus are the ones you have already seen in this run, so send the whole quarter in one reply: the Energy actions, the main action and `observe`.
weaknesses.problem: This assumes choice numbers and menu order never change. That breaks the robustness requirement. If menu order, Energy cost or availability changes, the batched calls spend Energy on the wrong actions or pick the wrong main action, with no check before they run.
weaknesses.fix: Pick actions by name or effect, not by remembered numbers. Batch the quarter only after the opening `observe` of this quarter confirms that the same numbers map to the same actions. Otherwise go back to the two-reply quarter. After any `success` false, re-read the menu before you continue.

weaknesses.quote: Output falls when extra work that is not your own deliverable takes your time or your credit: coaching someone through a problem, writing a formal note or recognition, joining someone else's review or meeting, investigations, rework or the slow thorough path, rest, giving the credit away.
weaknesses.problem: The story section is long lists of guessed wording cues, and several of them overlap or conflict. For example, coaching raises Skill in one list and lowers Output in another, and owning a mistake lowers risk but also means redoing work. The file is also dense with cross-references (Story step 4, Quarterly line 6, strict mode, the stalled-start exception). That makes it hard for a flash model to apply the rules the same way each time, and it costs tokens on every reread.
weaknesses.fix: Shorten each stat's cue list to 3–4 core verbs. Add one tie-break rule for options that move stats in opposite directions, for example 'when an option raises one tracked stat and lowers another, count it as neutral unless it is a review month'. Replace the cross-reference chains with one short priority table: survive, risk, wellbeing, review, grow.

weaknesses.quote: Reviews come every six months (handbook). The handbook lists the review after the quarterly phase; in our runs the half-year talk, the bonus and any promotion appeared among the events as months 6, 12, 18 … 48 began
weaknesses.problem: Relies on observed, unpublished timing and empirical claims ("in our runs") and builds a mod-6 calendar and review-month protections on them. This risks inventing mechanics and conflicts with the handbook's order, where the review follows the quarterly phase. Much of the strategy hangs on these assumptions.
weaknesses.fix: Base timing only on the published rules: a review every 6 months, after the quarterly phase. Protect Skill, Network and Output in the final 1–2 months before each review. Drop the unverifiable claims, or make them a short, clearly labelled heuristic that defers to what `observe` shows.

weaknesses.quote: Before choosing, read every option for the likely sign of its effect on Skill, Network, Output, Health, Dignity, Wealth and hidden risk. The game does not publish these effects; the wording cues below are our working assumptions
weaknesses.problem: The long keyword-cue lists and multi-step story procedure (survive, risk, strict mode, review-month exception, stalled start, wellbeing, review close, grow) are dense and nested. They map option wording to hidden effects, which is brittle when event wording changes and hard for a flash model to apply consistently. Several branches overlap and contradict each other, such as the review exception against strict mode.
weaknesses.fix: Cut this to a compact priority ladder: (1) avoid options that could end the run, (2) avoid hiding or blaming, (3) protect Health and Dignity at their thresholds, (4) pick the option that best builds Skill, Network and Output. Reduce the cue lists to a few principles rather than exhaustive keyword lists, and fold the stalled-start and review-month special cases into one short rule.

weaknesses.quote: Every call resends the whole conversation, so the run stays within budget only if each decision costs one reply: tool calls in one reply run in order... **Set the pattern in your first three replies and keep it:**
weaknesses.problem: A large share of the Skill is tool-call choreography and bookkeeping: a mandatory status-line note with Best, Now and Reviews here, plus the reply-shape rules. This competes with strategy for attention and adds failure points (note arithmetic, state tracking). Some of it, such as 'Reviews here: 2 means the stalled-start rule applies', is an invented mechanic. The 48-month plan is thin, and the table is mostly 'in our runs' observations.
weaknesses.fix: Move the turn-loop mechanics into a short separate section or Skill and keep the note to a one-line summary of stats and month. Add a real horizon plan, for example a build phase (months 1–18), a promotion-push phase (19–40) and a consolidation phase (41–48). Give explicit numeric margins for Health and Dignity and for wealth building.

weaknesses.quote: In our runs Network and Skill fill up within a few months and Output is the one that lags
weaknesses.problem: Observations from the authors' own runs (for example 'one point of Network or Output lost in the review month cost the first promotion' and 'dismissed at month 24') are written as if they were facts. The skill also asserts that reviews appear at the start of months 6, 12 and so on, and that story options have a particular effect on each stat. The handbook does not publish any of this, so it risks steering the agent wrongly and invents mechanics.
weaknesses.fix: Cut the anecdotal claims or reduce them to one short 'heuristic, verify against observe' note. Base the decisions on the stat changes shown in observe and on the published rules.

weaknesses.quote: Every call resends the whole conversation, so the run stays within budget only if each decision costs one reply: tool calls in one reply run in order... Set the pattern in your first three replies and keep it
weaknesses.problem: The Skill is very long and dense. It has a turn-loop protocol, a status line with Best and Reviews-here counters, and 5-step story rules with nested exceptions, mixed with the quarterly logic. This overloads a small model, and the counters are easy to get wrong. The order of the Energy menu and main-action phase is also complicated (two replies in the first quarter, one afterwards).
weaknesses.fix: Cut it to about half the length. Keep a short, ranked decision list, drop the Best and Reviews-here counters, and put the I/O protocol in one short block.

weaknesses.quote: Main action Apply for a key project.
weaknesses.problem: The quarterly plan is nearly fixed by level ('Levels 2 and 3: Prepare report materials, Network maintenance, Prepare report materials' and 'Level 4 or above: Skill learning ... Apply for rotation'). It does not adapt to the actual weakest stat, and Skill is neglected at low levels. Skill is a scored ending dimension and a promotion input, and it must not fall behind. The plan also gives no explicit way to balance wealth, risk, or the 48-month ending dimensions.
weaknesses.fix: Replace the fixed per-level scripts with a rule that picks the action raising the lowest of Skill, Network and Output (and Health and Dignity if they are low), and that states the ending-score dimensions.
